article_context: Body image 03 illustrates the attraction «На крыльях ветра» in the recommended after-16 route: an immersive dinosaur-world flight that delivers a sense of full involvement and exhilaration.
image_reading: Silhouetted rows of suspended ride seats face a bright prehistoric jungle valley with cliffs and a smoking volcano.
A large winged pterosaur flies across the open view; its wings and the distant haze are the clearest motion cues.
The contrast between the dark ride interior and the vivid projected landscape makes the viewer feel inside the flight attraction.

models.positive_prompt: The pterosaur glides steadily across the jungle valley from right to left, wings beating slowly as mist drifts below; the ride seats remain in silhouette. End with the pterosaur fully visible above the treetops near the left side of the view.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, the pterosaur begins a smooth, moderate leftward glide through the central projection, with two slow natural wingbeats and subtle moving valley mist. Keep the camera fixed from the riders’ viewpoint and retain the seat silhouettes. By the final frames, the pterosaur has crossed to the left side above the forest canopy, still clearly visible.

models.positive_prompt: From the riders’ view, the pterosaur sweeps in a smooth arc across the prehistoric valley while light mist moves through the jungle. Hold the fixed viewpoint; finish with it gliding clearly above the left treetops.
models.scene_plan: For this five-second shot, hold the immersive ride viewpoint steady. Let the pterosaur continue its broad, controlled flight from the right across the open valley, its wings flexing at an even pace while faint mist flows over the forest. The flight resolves near the end when it reaches the left treetops without leaving the view.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed riders’ viewpoint: the pterosaur glides from right toward the left over the jungle, with one slow wingbeat and drifting valley mist. End with the pterosaur clearly suspended above the left-side canopy.
models.scene_plan: Use the compact four-second duration for a single focused glide. The pterosaur immediately moves leftward over the valley with one measured wingbeat; light mist shifts beneath it, while the ride seating stays silhouetted and stable. Near the end it settles into a clear visible glide above the left canopy.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation supports the attraction’s promise of an absorbing, thrilling flight through a dinosaur world.
structured_intent.primary_action: The visible pterosaur makes one continuous flight across the prehistoric valley.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The scene remains an immersive, awe-filled dinosaur-flight experience viewed from the attraction.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The pterosaur is still clearly visible gliding above the left-side jungle canopy in the final frame.
